# Focused on the Fight
## Scripture
"Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil." – Ephesians 6:11

## Reflection
As warriors of Christ, we are called to stand firm against the enemy's schemes. But standing firm requires focus and attention. We cannot allow distractions to pull us away from our mission. The Bible teaches us to put on the whole armor of God, which includes the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, and the shield of faith. By putting on this armor, we are better equipped to face the challenges that come our way.

But what does it mean to put on this armor? It means to intentionally focus on God's truth and to stand on the foundation of His righteousness. It means to trust in God's goodness and to stand firm against the enemy's lies. As warriors of Christ, we must be intentional about putting on this armor every day, so we can stand strong against the schemes of the devil.

## Daily Challenge
"Do 25 squats while declaring God's truth over your life."
